intro.title: From Ideas to Value
intro.subtitle:
I'm Golden Ogbeka — a Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack AI Engineer, and former CTO with 7+ years of experience building technology across fintech, banking, commerce, logistics, and edtech. From enterprise corporate banking platforms and high-impact financial systems to modern web and mobile products, distributed architectures, and emerging AI/ML solutions, I've worked across the technology stack to solve problems that matter.

I combine engineering depth, system design, AI, product thinking, and business understanding to build software that is not only technically sound, but secure, scalable, maintainable, and useful to the people and businesses it serves.
